subject: Dedicated GPU pool: kickoff, throughput targets & stakeholder heatmap
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver James <oliver.james@nimbushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated GPU pool: kickoff, throughput targets & stakeholder heatmap

Hi Oliver (and team),

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our conversation, I want to kick off a short MAP to align on capacity commitments, throughput targets for your inference workloads, and who owns each track during the trial and ramp. Goal: agree on a 6-week plan for a Dedicated GPU pool trial that lets Nimbus validate latency/SLOs and unit economics before committing to a reserved pool.

Proposed high-level milestones:
- Week 0 (this week): stakeholder roster + technical intake (sample prompts, seq lengths, peak qps)
- Week 1: initial dedicated trial provisioned (2 x A100 equivalent slots) + baseline throughput run
- Weeks 2–3: throughput tuning (batching/kv-cache) and quantization recommendations
- Week 4: evaluation run & QoE checks (prompt set)
- Week 5: economics review and go/no-go decision

I've attached a short "stakeholder heatmap" and initial throughput targets doc to help orient the group. Can everyone confirm the right person for each track below and any missing stakeholders?

Stakeholder asks (please reply in-thread with names/roles):
- Technical lead (integrations, test harness) — ideally a Dev/ML engineer who can share runbooks and sample prompts
- Performance owner (throughput/latency sign-off)
- Procurement contact for PO/terms
- Security/compliance contact for SOC2 evidence requests
- Success manager for weekly cadence and tickets

Internal leads from Redwood included here: Marissa (onboarding & eval plan), Dylan (capacity provisioning), Karthik (pricing/commitment), Priyom (trial orchestration).

Next steps: Oliver, if you can confirm technical lead and procurement point-of-contact by EOD Tuesday, I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff this week and share a one-page MAP with ownership and dates.

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0241

Attachments: MAP-stakeholder-heatmap-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), throughput-targets-v2.pdf (doc)

From: Oliver James <oliver.james@nimbushealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimbushealth.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@cloudops.co>, J. Rivera <j.rivera@compliancepartners.io>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool: kickoff, throughput targets & stakeholder heatmap

Thanks Mina — this looks great and in line with what we discussed. Quick answers:
- Technical lead: Aisha Khan (cloudops lead) — she'll own integration and will share the test harness.
- Procurement: procurement@nimbushealth.com (cc'd) — they handle PO/terms.
- Security/compliance contact: J. Rivera from Compliance Partners (cc'd) — they'll validate evidence scope.

We'd like the initial trial to exercise a 75 p95 latency target for our NER + clinical summarization pipeline (seq lengths vary; avg 256 tokens, spikes to 1024). Throughput target: sustained 120 qps during business hours, with 250 qps burst capacity.

Let's do the 30-min kickoff on Monday morning if that works for Redwood. Oliver

--
Oliver James
Head of ML Platforms | Nimbus Health
oliver.james@nimbushealth.com | +1 617-555-0102

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Oliver James <oliver.james@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Jul 2028 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool: kickoff, throughput targets & stakeholder heatmap

Thanks Oliver — helpful targets. I've sketched an evaluation plan and split ownership into three tracks: Technical Integration, Performance & Throughput, and Commercial (terms & economics). High-level owner matrix (attached spreadsheet):

- Technical Integration: Aisha Khan (Nimbus) + Marissa (Redwood onboarding) — tasks: sample prompt ingestion, harness, config for KV cache
- Performance & Throughput: Aisha (executes), Dylan (provisions/batch tuning), Marissa (eval scripts + pass/fail criteria) — tasks: run baseline, iterate batching, record p95/p99, cost per token
- Commercial: Procurement (Nimbus), Karthik (Redwood pricing), Mina (stakeholder coordination) — tasks: review trial T&Cs, PO path, potential SLA exceptions

Eval criteria draft (please comment):
1) Latency: p95 <= 75ms for short prompts; p95 <= 750ms for long prompts (note: numbers are example baselines)
2) Throughput: sustain 120 qps at 95% of test windows, burst to 250 qps for 60s
3) Cost: cost per 1k tokens below committed threshold in bucket
4) Functional quality: example prompt set must have zero regression against baseline outputs

I've added a column in the heatmap for "backstop owners" in case someone is unavailable. Oliver — can you and Aisha fill in the Nimbus-side owners directly in the sheet? I'll convert the sheet into a one-page MAP after we get confirmations.

Marissa Cole
Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: MAP-stakeholder-heatmap-v1.xlsx

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool: kickoff, throughput targets & stakeholder heatmap

Quick note from infra: I can provision an initial 2-slot pool (A100 equiv) by EOD Tuesday and add autoscaling to allow burst capacity up to 4 slots for the trial. Two operational asks:
- Provide a sample 1-hour traffic trace and peak windows (Aisha) so we can pre-warm and size batches appropriately
- Confirm durable KV cache footprint and expected sequence length distribution (avg/95/99)

If those look good I will pre-stage images and a baseline perf-run script; Marissa — I'll hand the run artifact to you for evaluation captures.

--
Dylan Brooks
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool: kickoff, throughput targets & stakeholder heatmap

Appreciate the quick turnarounds, everyone. Action items captured:
- Nimbus: Aisha to drop sample traffic trace + sequence distribution by EOD Wednesday (Aisha)
- Redwood infra: Dylan to provision 2-slot trial with burst to 4 slots (target Tue EOD)
- Onboarding: Marissa to publish one-page MAP and evaluation runbook once Nimbus fills owners in the sheet
- Commercial: Procurement to confirm PO path; Karthik to prepare trial pricing addendum

I'll schedule the 30-min kickoff for Wednesday 09:30 PT and share a calendar invite and the one-page MAP after Aisha uploads the trace. If anyone needs a different time, flag in-thread.

Thanks — Mina
